# Prajwal Sainju

> Prajwal Sainju is a frontend and backend web developer based in Kathmandu, Nepal, building web applications with Laravel and PHP on the server and Vue.js with TypeScript on the client. Prajwal is currently a developer intern at Futech Solution and open to new opportunities.

Key facts:

- Role: Frontend & Backend Developer Intern at Futech Solution, Kathmandu (December 2025 to present)
- Main stack: Laravel, PHP, Blade, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Vue.js, TypeScript, SCSS
- Also uses: React, Inertia.js, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Git
- Education: BCA, Arunima College
- Location: Kathmandu, Nepal
- Contact: sainjoprajol12@gmail.com, +977 9841273490
- Profiles: https://www.linkedin.com/in/prajwal-sainju/ and https://github.com/sanjoprajol12
